evidence_summary: Three consistent repros of quick-create (dimension=4, metricType=L2) with top-level shardsNum=0, -1 and 65535 all returning 200/code=0.
rationale: Maintainer cognition [issue 50351] documents that top-level shardsNum is NOT consumed by the REST v2 quick-create API and is silently ignored by design (consumed only via params.shardsNum), so the 200s evidence silent ignoring of an unconsumed field rather than acceptance of an invalid shard count, and no follow-up request (e.g. describe) shows the invalid value took effect; the shardsNum>=1 constraint targets the consumed parameter, which was never sent.
